targeted: Generic engineering, academic/technical percentage distinctions, quoted text, backend failures, assistant identity, capability inventory and previous-message recall; native normal, research and long-audit dispatch preserve the complete prompt. Actual owned subprocess tests force terminal output between EOF and exit and reject incomplete output.

actual_reply_render.scope: Native rendering of the actual previously recorded model output, with motion and Glass enabled. No new or substituted inference.

model_check_limit: One actual local 4B Qwen model, capped at 768 generated tokens. It produced an on-topic engineering response; numerical accuracy and completion of the full audit are not established. The reply contains unverified assumptions and must not be treated as engineering validation. The later media-process drain repair does not change chat routing; final regression covers both changes.
